title: Laredo Realtors Built Beds for Kids — Tonight, Casino Night Raises Scholarship Money
excerpt: Volunteers with the Laredo Association of Realtors spent a Saturday in October building beds for children who needed one. Tonight, the same association is raising money for local students — Casino Night at the Falcon Bank Event Center, with proceeds going to scholarship grants.
content:
Volunteers with the Laredo Association of Realtors spent a Saturday in October building beds for children who needed one. Tonight, the same association is raising money for local students — Casino Night at the Falcon Bank Event Center, with proceeds going to scholarship grants.

The Build-A-Bed event took place Saturday, Oct. 24, at QXO, 1906 Freight St. Volunteers turned lumber into beds for local children, and the association collected donations of new twin-size sheet sets, crib-size sheets, pillows, comforters, blankets and stuffed animals at its office, 107 Calle Del Norte, Suite 21.

"Every child deserves a bed to call their own," the association said in announcing the event, thanking QXO for hosting and the volunteers who "rolled up their sleeves."

Tonight's Casino Night runs from 6 p.m. at the Falcon Bank Event Center, with live music, games, prizes and raffles, food and a silent auction. All proceeds benefit the association's scholarship grants, which help local students pay for their education. The association's scholarship program awards $1,000 scholarships to local students.

It is a small, local example of the same pattern Webb Watch 956 keeps seeing in Laredo: neighbors organizing, businesses donating space, and the money staying here to help kids.
